newsitem.title: USA: Mobil says Calif. refinery fully restarted.
newsitem.headline: Mobil says Calif. refinery fully restarted.

text.p: Mobil Corp on Tuesday said it has restarted all units at its 130,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery south of Los Angeles, following a two-week start-up which helped raise wholesale gasoline prices.
Mobil shut several units for planned maintenance in January, including the crude and 47,500 bpd coker.
"It's been coming up in stages and its been fully up since this weekend," said a plant spokeswoman.
The plant started up in early March and traders said its prolonged return helped lift CARB-grade unleaded gasoline prices 6.5 cents a gallon last week, amid low regional supply.
"It's been real tight," a trader said, noting that gasoline supply rebounded modestly last week to 26.7 million barrels from a relative low of 25.6 million on March 14.
